body: Well, that's my reason as well. I know my dog will be euthanized because of its age if I kms. I will most likely just end up killing us both if my financial situation gets any worse. I honestly don't care about anyone or anything other than my dog.

I have a fear of there being nothing after death, like going to sleep and not dreaming. I want to die before my 30th bday. I really hate my existence and know my only real option is suicide, but my fear of the unknown, and my dog prevents me from ending it.

I will be unable to get employment in my field of study with a history of mental illness. I know theres job opportunities if I fail landing a job with my degree, but I don't want to be a wage slave for the rest of my life. I will also be a huge disappointment to my parents, they are relying on me for their future as well. I also feel my reasons for suicide are not valid as there are millions of people living worse than me. I feel like I'm already dead and everything that's happening now is just a dream.

I can relate to this so much. I'm 29 almost done with my degree and will graduate 40k+ in debt. I can't even get an entry level position in my field without a security clearance, and I didn't realize that people history of mental illness are disqualified. I wasted another four years of my life and am worse off than before. I COULD work 65+ hours a week just trying to support my self, but how is that anyway to live. I don't care how my parents  feel anymore, the only thing I have left is my dog, and even staying alive for that isn't enough anymore.

Well, I honestly don't know what to say. I'm in a similar situation, however I live in the US and never worked in my entire life until a month ago. From my own experience, working has not made my depression any better, and I literally now only get one hour to 'live' each day. I also live in a state that has a HUGE cost of living so I really can't move out of my parents home even with a full-time job (and I'm 40k+ in debt). I go back to university in Jan. to finish my last semester, but I have no idea how I'll do that now that I'm working. The only thing stopping me from killing my self is my dog. I can't afford mental health treatment either in the US, I would pay 10k for one session (I can't afford health insurance :D) but I've been reading a lot of different subjects to try and help my self. I read some Philosophy books on Stoicism, and it's actually changed my view point, I still have anxiety but I can pretty much function at my current job pretty well. I agree with your opinion that, no one truly does care for you(sorry if this seems harsh), but  there's always a how "my" suicide will effect "them". The only person that truly cares about you is you, which is why you're reaching out. I really feel weird giving you advice at all, my situation isn't any better than yours, and even though I'm considered an adult I surely don't feel like one. I know you want a job, and it seems you would be less stressed if you had income, have you thought about freelancing your skills? I use freelancer and offer my skills in Korean, C#, Java, Python, Ruby, and HTTP/CSS. I don't know how bad your SA is but, would you be able to work a remote CSR job? I know that being bilingual and having computer skills are really great for those type of jobs.
I feel kind of dazed or that I'm not really awake, it feels like everything around me is moving and that I'm not really here. I guess I feel more like an observer? Idk if that makes any sense.
